title: MEOW'S UTILITIES V2 (KEYLESS)
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local LoadingGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LoadingGui.Name = "LoadingScreen"
LoadingGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
LoadingGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local LoadingFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LoadingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
LoadingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
LoadingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
LoadingFrame.Parent = LoadingGui

local LoadingText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LoadingText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
LoadingText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.42, 0)
LoadingText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadingText.Text = "Cargando Script..."
LoadingText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
LoadingText.TextSize = 32
LoadingText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
LoadingText.Parent = LoadingFrame

local SubText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SubText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SubText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.48, 0)
SubText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SubText.Text = "made by @7w7laos (meow)"
SubText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
SubText.TextSize = 18
SubText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SubText.Parent = LoadingFrame

local ProgressBarBG = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBarBG.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 8)
ProgressBarBG.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.56, 0)
ProgressBarBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
ProgressBarBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBarBG.Parent = LoadingFrame

local ProgressBar = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ProgressBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ProgressBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBar.Parent = ProgressBarBG

local UICornerBar = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICornerBar.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
UICornerBar.Parent = ProgressBarBG

local UICornerBar2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICornerBar2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
UICornerBar2.Parent = ProgressBar

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local tween = TweenService:Create(ProgressBar, tweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)})
tween:Play()
tween.Completed:Wait()

task.wait(0.5)
LoadingGui:Destroy()

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "InvisSprintGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
ScreenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 110)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 15)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = MainFrame

local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UIStroke.Thickness = 1.5
UIStroke.Parent = MainFrame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "INVIS + SPRINT"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local InvisButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
InvisButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 32)
InvisButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 30)
InvisButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
InvisButton.Text = "Invisibilidad"
InvisButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
InvisButton.TextSize = 13
InvisButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
InvisButton.Parent = MainFrame

local InvisCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
InvisCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
InvisCorner.Parent = InvisButton

local SprintButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SprintButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 32)
SprintButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 68)
SprintButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
SprintButton.Text = "Sprint"
SprintButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SprintButton.TextSize = 13
SprintButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SprintButton.Parent = MainFrame

local SprintCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SprintCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
SprintCorner.Parent = SprintButton

local invisActive = false
local invisCooldown = false
local sprintActive = false
local sprintCooldown = false

local originalTransparency = {}
local originalWalkSpeed = 16

local function toggleInvisibility()
	if invisCooldown or invisActive then return end

	invisActive = true
	invisCooldown = true
	InvisButton.Text = "Invis: ON (10s)"
	InvisButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

	for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
			originalTransparency[part] = part.Transparency
			part.Transparency = 1
		elseif part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or part:IsA("Trail") then
			part.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	task.delay(10, function()
		if character and character.Parent then
			for part, trans in pairs(originalTransparency) do
				if part and part.Parent then
					part.Transparency = trans
				end
			end
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or part:IsA("Trail") then
					part.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		end
		invisActive = false
		InvisButton.Text = "Cooldown (15s)"
		InvisButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	end)

	task.delay(25, function()
		invisCooldown = false
		InvisButton.Text = "Invisibilidad"
		InvisButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	end)
end

local function toggleSprint()
	if sprintCooldown or sprintActive then return end

	sprintActive = true
	sprintCooldown = true
	SprintButton.Text = "Sprint: ON (3s)"
	SprintButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

	originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 35

	task.delay(3, function()
		if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
		end
		sprintActive = false
		SprintButton.Text = "Cooldown (5s)"
		SprintButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	end)

	task.delay(8, function()
		sprintCooldown = false
		SprintButton.Text = "Sprint"
		SprintButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	end)
end

InvisButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleInvisibility)
SprintButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleSprint)

InvisButton.TouchTap:Connect(toggleInvisibility)
SprintButton.TouchTap:Connect(toggleSprint)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
	character = newChar
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	originalTransparency = {}
	invisActive = false
	sprintActive = false
end)

print("Script Invis + Sprint cargado correctamente")
